article.story: CHARLESTON, S.C. -- — Tavari Johnson had 20 points in Charleston‘s 90-66 victory over South Carolina State on Sunday. Johnson also contributed five rebounds for the Cougars (4-0). Xavier Abreu scored 16 points while shooting 6 of 9 from the field and 4 for 4 from the line. Ben Bradford finished 5 of 8 from the field to finish with 12 points. Deshaun Jackson Jr. led the way for the Bulldogs (3-2) with 13 points. South Carolina State also got 10 points from Treven Raymon. Charleston took the lead for good with 6:18 left in the first half. The score was 34-27 at halftime, with Abreu racking up 12 points. Charleston extended its lead to 44-29 during the second half, fueled by an 8-0 scoring run. Bradford scored a team-high 10 points in the second half. Up next Charleston plays Thursday against Drake on the road. South Carolina State visits Citadel on Friday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
